title: ProcedureIntelligenceToolContract
description: Standardized contract for tools exposed via Model Context Protocol (MCP) in the Procedure Intelligence Framework.

name.description: Unique identifier name for the tool.

description.description: Clear, detailed explanation of what the procedure accomplishes, its side-effects, and preconditions.

is_side_effecting.description: True if executing the procedure alters environmental or database state.

requires_hitl_approval.description: True if execution requires explicit human-in-the-loop approval due to non-reversible side effects.

precondition.description: Mathematical precondition logic formula {P} that must evaluate to true before invocation.

postcondition.description: Mathematical postcondition logic formula {Q} guaranteed upon successful termination.

inputSchema.description: Strict JSON Schema governing required arguments and parameter types.

outputSchema.description: Strict JSON Schema governing return data structures.
